home.mainText:
Laboratory for Intelligent Process Engineering
Welcome to Laboratory for Intelligent Process Engineering (LIPE) 지능형공정공학연구실!

The goal of research in the BK group is to develop computational methods and tools for problems in the process systems engineering (PSE) field.

If you are interested in our research group, please feel free to contact Prof. Boeun Kim, 김보은 via bkim@kongju.ac.kr
